find.match_belief: I was drawn to the entertainment industry because of its crossover with tech and business. Good ideas become experiences that genuinely connect with people! I love being part of the work behind the scenes that brings those moments to life, and I believe entertainment has a unique ability to inspire and add something meaningful to everyday life.

profile.belief: I first fell in love with animation as a child. In addition to the usual Saturday morning cartoon rotation of the early 2000s, I would also pop in VHS tapes and CDs of Soviet Animation that my parents grew up with in the USSR. I became obsessed with learning how it all worked. Years later, I learned exactly that, and graduated at the top of my class from the School of Visual Arts in NYC with a BFA in Animation. Now, I itch to tell my stories through animation, and help others tell theirs.
profile.working_on: My goal is to become a producer and help shepherd the next generation of animated storytelling.
